purpose: Privileged deterministic-policy-gradient headroom kill gate for the joint cache-edge and packet-weight Lyapunov objective.
owner_schedule: independent random permutation within every five-launch epoch
cache_action_class: null or one directed chain-neighbor refresh per launch

mandatory_gates.H5_owner_coverage: at least four launches per owner per scenario
mandatory_gates.H6_fully_charged_diagnostic: all public and counterfactual simulator transitions counted
mandatory_gates.H7_reference_signal: positive ideal-reference decrease in every cell
mandatory_gates.H10_active_direction: exact oracle strictly beats strong online envelope in >= 75% active cells
mandatory_gates.H12_joint_weight_nontrivial: every active cell has between one and twenty positive packet weights

decision_rule: Any mandatory failure stops Multiwalker alignment-controller fitting. Passing authorizes only a separate selected-feedback critic development split, not a formal or GPU experiment.
resource_scope: local CPU only; no HPC4, GPU, or /project writes
taint_rule: The privileged gradients, counterfactual actions, exact optimizer, and development seeds may not be consumed by a deployable controller or later confirmation analysis.
